Sorry we missed each other for the scheduled walkthrough earlier. I pulled together two quick paths to get your Glimmer.ai sandbox running so you can validate the Redwood inference flow without waiting on a full integration:

I attached a one-page checklist (sandbox-setup-checklist.pdf) and a short agenda. If you want the bootcamp, two slots I have this week: Wed 11/18 10:00 AM PT or Thu 11/18 2:00 PM PT — which works better? If neither, tell me a window and I’ll loop in our AE to coordinate.

Also: could you confirm the environment we'll use (staging key vs. production test key) and whether anyone else on your team will join? That helps us bring the right engineer.

Thanks — quick wins here are common once the connectors are in place.
